versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g If the <LdComUser_LdComCbkTpTxConfirma- tion> notification callback is configured in the LdCom High Proxy (via the LdComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_LdCom_00023]) parameter, where the LdComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_LdCom_00025]) is set to LDCOM_TP_- TX_CONFIRMATION ), the configured <LdComUser_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation> callback shall be invoked, when the associated instance of the SwCluC_Ld- ComProxy_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation from the LdCom Low Proxy is called.
